identity.name: Global Spine Journal
identity.source_note: Live guide https://journals.sagepub.com/author-instructions/gsj is Cloudflare-blocked (403 'Just a moment' challenge); WebFetch, Apify rag-web-browser headless render, two Apify Cloudflare-bypass actors (pamberton/cloudflare-bypass, macheta/universal-bypasser), Jina reader, and allorigins/corsproxy all failed to clear it. No Wayback snapshot within 12 months (latest good capture 20240303 is >12mo and NOT used as an encoding source; the 20250114 capture is itself a captured 403). Values encoded from the authoritative SAGE journal landing page https://www.sagepub.com/en-us/nam/global-spine-journal/journal203377 (publisher, ISSN, double-blind, ScholarOne portal, no page limits) plus Google-indexed snippets of the live guide (structured-abstract sections; anonymization/title-page) plus the EndNote GSJ output filter (reference style). Journal-specific numerics (font, margins, word caps, DPI) left null.

encoding_notes: BLOCKED: live Guide for Authors (journals.sagepub.com/author-instructions/gsj) is Cloudflare-gated; could not be read via WebFetch, Apify headless render, two Cloudflare-bypass actors, Jina, or allorigins/corsproxy. No Wayback snapshot <=12mo (latest good = 2024-03-03, too old; 2025-01-14 = captured 403). Most numeric/format fields therefore null by design.
Publisher SAGE Publications (official journal of AO Spine); ISSN 2192-5682 (print), e-ISSN 2192-5690 — from authoritative SAGE landing page www.sagepub.com.

submission_system = ScholarOne Manuscripts, inferred from portal mc.manuscriptcentral.com/gsjournal (manuscriptcentral = ScholarOne). NOTE: some secondary sources say 'Editorial Manager', but the GSJ editors' PMC article (PMC8351074) uses 'Editorial Manager' as a PERSON/role title, not the Aries software — the actual portal is ScholarOne.

blinding: double_blind=true is authoritative ('Double-blind peer review policy', SAGE landing page). separate_title_page/scrub_body_identifiers corroborated by live-guide snippets ('manuscripts must be fully anonymized'; 'identifying information should be removed from the main manuscript document and included on the Title Page'). scrub_metadata=true is inferred from the full-anonymization requirement (not separately quoted).

abstract.structured=true with sections Study Design/Objectives/Methods/Results/Conclusions — GSJ-specific, corroborated across multiple indexed snippets. abstract.max_words left null: one synthesized source said 250 words but it was not confirmable from an authoritative fetch.
keywords.required=true (corroborated). min/max left null due to conflicting synthesized values (one source '>=3 keywords', another '4-8 keywords').

article_types: original_research, review, systematic_review, case_report, letter encoded (mapped from 'Original Papers/Review Papers/Case Reports/Letters' + GSJ's structured-abstract Study Design accommodating systematic reviews/meta-analyses). The authoritative type taxonomy was Cloudflare-blocked, so editorial and technical_note are plausibly accepted but were NOT confirmable and are omitted.

references.style=vancouver + in_text=bracket derived from EndNote's current GSJ output filter labelled 'Non-superscripted Number' (numeric, NON-superscript) + numbered/cited order. This CONTRADICTS one secondary source that claimed 'AMA Manual of Style' (AMA is superscript); EndNote's concrete filter was preferred. bracket-vs-paren for in_text is LOW confidence. journal_abbrev=nlm and include_doi=false are conservative defaults, not read from the guide.

word_limits and sections left empty {}: no per-type section order or word caps were readable. The SAGE landing page states 'No page limits or page charges' — i.e. no manuscript length cap — which is consistent with manuscript_max_words being unconstrained.

FORCED-ENUM conservative defaults (schema allows no null): layout.line_numbers='none', tables.placement='in_text', figures.legends_location='in_text' were set to the non-transforming value because the guide could not be read — treat as UNVERIFIED, not asserted requirements.

declarations.order left [] and required null: SAGE house-style typically mandates Declaration of Conflicting Interests + Funding (+ ethics/consent), but the specific GSJ list/order was not readable and the SAGE generic house-style page (www.sagepub.com/en-us/sam/manuscript-submission-guidelines) 404'd.

CONFIDENCE: medium-low overall. Blinding, abstract structure, publisher/ISSN, submission system are solid; layout/figure/table/reference-detail values are conservative defaults pending a successful read of the blocked live guide (recommend headless recheck at launch / Janine spot-audit).
2026-07-18 doctrine audit: line_numbers 'none' was a default, not a guide statement — nulled so the engine preserves the author's setting.
